backup.title: Backup centre
backup.description: Copy patient files and recordings to a folder on this computer or a USB drive, check the copies, export the whole database, and free up cloud space once files are safely copied.
backup.unsupported: The Backup centre needs Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a computer (it saves into a folder you choose). Please open this page there.

backup.step1Hint: Pick a folder on this computer or a USB drive. The browser asks once to allow saving there. Use the same folder each time.
backup.step2Hint: Each file is downloaded, saved by kind and month, read back and checked (SHA-256). Only checked copies count. You can stop and carry on later; nothing is copied twice.
backup.beforeHint: Leave empty to copy everything not yet backed up.

backup.step3Hint: Reads every file of the last backup back from the folder. A copy that changed or went missing loses its “backed up” mark, so it is copied again next time and can't be purged.
backup.checkBad: {ok} copies fine, {bad} changed or missing. Run the backup again.
backup.exportHint: Saves every table (patients, bills, stock, leads…) into the folder, under database and then the date. Do this every week; on Monday morning you get a reminder if you haven't.
backup.purgeHint: Removes old recordings and visit photos from the cloud: only files with a checked copy in a backup. Patient records, scans and bills are never removed.
backup.blockedHint: Files without a checked copy are kept. Back them up first, then come back.
